name: 1262-batchdecode-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- the ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies. Same weights, ~16 GB of bf16.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 20000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix and no shared structure: 20 prompt tokens in and exactly 128 tokens out, both FIXED with no spread; temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request generates its full 128 tokens. Driven over `/v1/completions`.
purpose: A short-prompt autocomplete service on an eight-billion-parameter model, serving 1024 concurrent 128-token completions from one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine then
# runs without the mechanism this file declares.
# The model path is NousResearch's ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
context-length: 4096
max-running-requests: 4096
chunked-prefill-size: -1
disable-radix-cache: true
disable-cuda-graph: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
